study type: Retrospective cohort study with propensity score matching
cohort: The study included 329,254 infants who were less than 37 weeks of gestation, without major congenital anomalies, and discharged from 327 United States neonatal intensive care units between 2004 and 2013.
finding: Gastrostomy tube use in premature infants was not associated with improved short-term daily weight gain, although daily weight gain was significantly less during days 8-14 post-placement compared with 14 days pre-placement.
followup_time: Observation windows of 7, 14, or 30 days pre-placement, post-placement, and prior to discharge were used for weight gain assessment.
